SECRET_INTERCEPTION.title: Zero-Day High-Entropy Secret Defense
SECRET_INTERCEPTION.summary: Sub-millisecond Shannon entropy analysis blocking uncommitted keys directly in pre-commit hooks.
SECRET_INTERCEPTION.reply_text:
DevSuperSuite stops credentials from ever hitting remote repositories through mathematical tripwires:

• **Shannon Entropy Tripwire:** Measures character distribution disorder (H > 3.8 bits/char) to flag cryptographic private keys and high-entropy API tokens before execution.
• **Zero-Day Pattern Engine:** Detects AWS access keys (`AKIA...`), OpenAI API keys (`sk-...`), GCP Service Accounts, GitHub PATs, and Stripe secrets.
• **Pre-Commit Gate (< 4ms):** Integrates directly as a standalone Git pre-commit hook (`devsupersuite hook install --git`), rejecting commits locally before any outbound network call.

Unlike cloud-based scanners that notify you *after* a secret is leaked, DevSuperSuite blocks it locally at the workstation boundary.
